label: mcl_core_andesite_smooth
reference_prompt: Create a close visual reference for andesite that has been deliberately cut, ground and smoothed by old stoneworkers in a grounded dark-fantasy world. Preserve the dense fine volcanic mineral body of andesite, but let tooling remove rough fracture and expose a broad matte stone face. Fine abrasion, faint planar tool variation and occasional mineral grains should remain visible so it never becomes concrete or polished marble. Keep restrained medium gray and cool mineral undertones. Avoid mirror polish, tile glaze, perfect machine finish or featureless blur. The material should read as carefully finished volcanic stone whose geology remains visible beneath craftsmanship.
